confidence_notes: 2026 city price indexes inform the July meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass estimates use their relationship to local draft beer prices, with limited menu evidence. Lodging is modeled for a typical July night, with private hostel rooms the least certain. [Numbeo](https://es.numbeo.com/coste-de-vida/ciudad/Queretaro-Santiago-de-Queretaro-Mexico?displayCurrency=USD), [August restaurant prices](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/mexico/queretaro-santiago-de-queretaro-mexico/restaurants), [Expatistan](https://expatistan.com/cost-of-living/queretaro), [Santyago menu](https://www.santyago.com.mx/menu.pdf).
comparable_city_reasoning: Puebla provides a regional reference for budget lodging in a historic inland city. Querétaro’s mix of domestic tourism and business travel informs the three-star estimate.
